title: Python: physical-resource airtime admission
description:
Extend python/src/lichen/timing/duty_cycle.py to enforce provisioned operating-basis constraints and the retained adaptive ceiling against complete emissions. Account by actual physical frequency or regulatory group, not resettable plan indices. Include control, data, forwarding, retries and any admitted additional framing traffic. Remote information may only narrow local frequency, power, profile and budget permissions. Expose admission and emission accounting to the production LinkLayer.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse RegionalDutyCycleEnforcer rather than introducing a parallel accounting framework. The authority dependencies supply constraints, not an assumption of RF approval. Independent admission-test leaves will test this implementation and must not be prerequisites. Keep configured synthetic tests offline; unknown operating authority fails closed. Preserve baseline SCHC/security, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody and deferred key portability.
acceptance_criteria: Consume vectors.09 and independent configured constraints from authority.02/.05/.06 through production enforcement. Test legal-stricter and adaptive-stricter limits, alias indices and plan changes sharing an account, rolling interval boundaries, all transmission classes and remote expansion rejection. For an explicitly configured narrow-FHSS ledger, deny the second 250 ms emission on the same frequency within 20 seconds. Extend python/tests/timing/test_duty_cycle.py and focused LinkLayer tests; run pytest, ruff and scoped typing where configured.
